D.treatment: teacher and school contributions to achievement

cells.quote: The results are calculated using value-added models, which separate teachers’ contributions to student achievement from other factors.
cells.note: The study text describes the value-added approach and delivery of results but reports no directional finding, effect size, or comparative statistic.

O.outcome_detail: test scores used to estimate teacher value-added results

cells.quote: In this report, we provide an overview of the value-added model and describe value-added methods in non-technical terms, and we describe how we used test scores from the 2013–2014 school year and other information about teachers and students to estimate teacher value-added results.
cells.note: The available study text states the analytic purpose but reports no explicit treatment/comparison contrast, direction of findings, or printed effect size.

O.outcome_detail: three-year change in mathematics scale scores

cells.quote: We do not find any meaningful gains in student achievement for 2012–2014. Instead of average “growth,” achievement has declined for students in each letter grade category.
cells.note: The direction and contrast are reported in the wiki entry; the supplied study text shows the figure headings but not the full figure results. The entry states that F-school students had the largest average drops. The study does not print an effect size in the supplied text.
